text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, there you are!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer-san,
Happy New Year...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Yes! Um, I look forward to working with you again... this year as well!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...First, we should visit the shrine, right?

Today, I met up with Zenno Rob Roy for Hatsumode.
The idea was to make a wish for the upcoming
Classic campaign starting this year.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Have you thought of a wish yet, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Huh, mine is... s-secret!
It's kind of embarrassing, so...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (...May I become a true hero.)
"Just a feeling. It really was just a vague hunch, but suddenly, I wondered if we might be wishing for the exact same thing."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...Well then...
What should we do after this?"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, of course going back to the academy to train
would be fine too, though...!

Asked for my input, I ponder for a moment.
Since it's such a joyous day, I'd like to do something appropriate to celebrate, but...
choice_data_list: Buy some books and laze around for New Year's
Time to eat and drink at the stalls!
Let's take a stroll around the town decorated for New Year's.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Wah, how wonderful!
Since today is a full day off,
I might even get through a few books!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Phew... That was surprising.
I had no idea bookstores had New Year's sales too...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
you even bought a book lucky bag...
What kind of books were inside?

Upon opening the lucky bag I bought
while swept up in the mood—
choice_data_list: These are all titles I've never seen before...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...!
Ah, I know this author!
I read one of their novels, and their style is—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: —...Actually, it's a secret!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Since I had the rare chance to come across a book I wouldn't normally read...!
I thought it'd be more fun to read it without any prior info.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Finding out by reading is half the fun...
Fufu, it's just like drawing a fortune, isn't it?

That day was spent reading books peacefully with Zenno Rob Roy...
And so, a brand new year began!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
In that case...
I believe they were handing out sweet amazake over there.
Shall we head over...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
It's so warm and soothing...
Come to think of it, amazake is actually
a drink that appears in ancient myths.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"Speaking of heroes associated with alcohol,
Susanoo-no-Mikoto, who defeated the monster Yamata no Orochi by getting it drunk, is quite famous, but—"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Amazake won't get you drunk, so you can't slay any monsters with it.
However, some legends say it was created by a goddess, and it's extraordinarily good for your health.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
So apparently it's often drunk during New Year's,
and for me, being able to drink the same thing
as mythical heroes makes me so happy—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, I'm sorry for rambling on like that!
choice_data_list: It'd be great if we could share in the mythical hero's glory.
It'd be great if we could share in the mythical hero's glory.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
That's true...! My body feels all warm,
and I feel like my energy's coming back!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Now, what shall we eat next...!
Even after that, Zenno Rob Roy and I spent time eating all kinds of things from the food stalls. And with that, a brand-new year began!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Understood...!
Um, how about... in front of the station?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
You know that big stationery store?
I was curious about their New Year's sale...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: W-What a huge crowd...! The stationery store is across from the station, though...
choice_data_list: I have to be careful not to get separated...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Yes! Um, first to the station—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Wait, eek...~

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (Right after they warned me, I got swallowed up by the crowd...!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
U-Umm...!
Excuse me, could you let me through, please...?!
(Chatter, chatter...)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: (Ugh, they can't hear me at all...! It's because I have zero presence...!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
(I could push my way through if I really wanted to,
but if I did that and ended up hurting someone, it'd be awful... What should I do...?)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer-san...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Whoa, Trainer!?
H-How did you know where I was...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I... I see...
I'm sorry for troubling you...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Um. I really don't want to get separated again, so—

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
If you don't mind...
may I hold onto the edge of your clothes?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
...Ehehe.

After that, Zenno Rob Roy and I looked around
at various goods in our target shops.
And so, a new year had begun!
